segments.text:
THE Church of Rome teacheth, that men by nature haue free will to doe good: and that men being stirred vp by the holy ghost, can of themselues will that which is good. But if this were so, why might wee not pray, Let my will be done? So farre forth as the will of man shall agree with Gods will:
but this cannot be, as wee see in the tenour of this petition.
